exposure: Level of experience of the practitioner who performed the CS
outcome: Prevalence of surgical site infection (SSI) after cesarean section (CS)
finding: The prevalence of SSI after CS was 11%, and risk factors included prolonged labor, prolonged rupture of membranes, increasing number of digital vaginal examinations, prolonged surgery, wound contamination class III, postoperative anemia, and CS conducted by junior practitioners.
